claims.sectionKey: La letra Бб se llama бэ
claims.summary: The letter Б is called бэ in Russian.
Б represents a voiced bilabial sound.

claims.sectionKey: En ruso puede pronunciarse como consonante dura [b] o suave (palatalizada) [bʲ]
claims.summary: Б can be pronounced as a hard [b] or a soft [bʲ] consonant depending on its context.

claims.sectionKey: Ante letras que suelen indicar palatalización, como и, е, ё, ю, я или ь, la consonante puede pronunciarse suave
claims.summary: Б can be pronounced as a soft [bʲ] when it appears before certain letters that typically cause palatalization.
